Options Pedal Alone With KUDU Button With ThorpyFx Button Quantity Decrease quantity for The KUDU | Overdrive Increase quantity for The KUDU | Overdrive Add to cart     Description KUDU is the drive enhancer you never knew you needed. It makes all your sounds, whether amp or pedal driven, bigger and better with more control. It's an overdrive that has a funny little story behind it. Dan Coggins, who you’ll know of Lovetone fame, designs pedals for ThorpyFx, but musical instruments and their associated gear remains to this day as a hobby for Thorpy. Well, knowing this, on Christmas 2024 Dan gifted Thorpy a modified pedal, which as always, sparks an idea for a new product. So, we took inspiration for this modified classic and created a pedal optimised for stacking with other pedals and amps. Why is it called KUDU?
